Horticalc 0.6.5 improves fertilizer selection and makes better use of wide
desktop windows.

## Highlights

- Added searchable fertilizer fields in Calculator. Product fragments such as
  `haka`, `313`, or `special` match anywhere in the catalogue name.
- Component rows can now be selected and removed directly instead of deleting
  rows from the end.
- Expanded the desktop workspace to use the available window width, especially
  improving the fertilizer editor on large displays.
- Clarified row selection and deletion guidance across all five interface
  languages and the usage guide.

Download the Windows installer, portable Windows ZIP, or Linux x86_64 archive
below. Matching SHA-256 files and GitHub Artifact Attestations are published
with the release.
